hero.title: SemGen Studio
hero.subtitle: Captions, translation and video dubbing in one click
hero.cardDescription: Add a video and we detect its language, then transcribe it.

edit.hint: Tap a word to fix it (Enter confirms). Hover a word to delete it or start a new line. Enter or Space pauses the video.
